reports.report_type_printed: Seven days preceding the General Election
reports.notes: Handwritten in black ink, block capitals. Political Party glyph reads 'RED' (three block letters R-E-D); it may be the filer's abbreviation for Republican but the third letter is written as a D, so it is transcribed exactly as it appears at LOW confidence - not normalized. Line 3 'Balance at Beginning' is written '$3446' with NO decimal point legible and the form's printed black arrow graphic overlapping its right edge; the four digits 3446 are transcribed verbatim at low confidence (the filer's own lines 4 and 5 would be consistent with 34.46, but no decimal is printed and nothing was arithmetic-derived here). Line 2 Column A is written as '1500' with a raised superscript '00' for cents (transcribed 1500.00); the dollar sign there is overwritten/struck. Line 7 is a single slashed-zero glyph, transcribed 0 at medium confidence. County date stamp OCT 27 PM12:31.
